title: 2024-25 NBA HOOPS Tribute #290 Zion Williamson New Orleans Pelicans
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2024-25 NBA Hoops Tribute trading card featuring Zion Williamson of the New Orleans Pelicans. Manufactured by Panini, this card is part of the base set with card number 290. It is a sports trading card from the National Basketball Association (NBA) league, specifically from the 2024-25 season.
